title: phyllorkis albida
intro: Phyllorkis albida, commonly known as the 'White-flowering Phyllorkis', is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Orchid family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in China, due to its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis albida include its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Phyllorkis albida include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
